corrections.corrected_reference: The FY2024 table reports revenue of $47,405 million for Compute & Networking and $13,517 million for Graphics. Compute & Networking includes the Data Center accelerated-computing platform, networking and other platforms/software. Graphics includes GeForce gaming/PC products and enterprise workstation/visual-computing products. NVIDIA identifies two operating segments. Its Data Center accelerated-computing platform is included in Compute & Networking; Data Center is not a third reportable segment.
corrections.reason: The original final clause could be read as putting the entire specialized-market Data Center revenue category inside one reportable segment. The verified Note17 wording places the Data Center accelerated-computing platform in Compute & Networking, and the filing separately identifies two operating segments. The correction narrows only this clause to those source-backed claims; it does not change the segment values, questions, expected facts, evidence spans, source text, model answers or original dataset.

source_evidence.text:
The Compute & Networking segment includes our Data Center accelerated computing platform; networking; automotive artificial intelligence, or AI, Cockpit,
autonomous driving development agreements, and autonomous vehicle solutions; electric vehicle computing platforms; Jetson for robotics and other embedded
platforms; NVIDIA AI Enterprise and other software; and DGX Cloud.

The Graphics segment includes GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs, the GeForce NOW game streaming service and related infrastructure, and solutions for
gaming platforms; Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics; virtual GPU software for cloud-based visual and virtual computing; automotive
platforms for infotainment systems; and Omniverse Enterprise software for building and operating 3D internet applications.

Our two operating segments are "Compute & Networking" and "Graphics." Refer to Note 17 of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements in Part IV,
Item 15 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for additional information.
